review.intent_summary: Group related evidence into explainable cases by event and entity while keeping derived relationships from inflating independent-source confirmation.

criteria.criterion: Evidence for different declared entities remains in separate cases even at the same event time.
Criteria met in multiple source datasets can raise numerical severity and identify the contributing sources.
A derived relationship adds context without counting as an additional independent source for severity.
Adaptive location-shift rules can create an early grouped case without a point trigger, using only evidence available at detection.

verification_evidence: Manual source tracing confirmed entity-aware grouping, dataset-only independent-source counting, and named source explanations.
Inspected adaptive assessment construction: only location-shift patterns qualify, earliest detection is selected, and referenced residuals are bounded by detection.
Inspected case construction for contributing targets, evidence references, explanations, investigation questions, and explicit limits on causal and business-impact claims.
remaining_gaps: Focused tests were inspected but not executed in this review.
The requested manual inspection of a generated case and comparison with a point-anomaly episode was not performed.

issues.message: Capability or implementation changed during review. Run the review again.
